name: {{project_name}}
description: {{project_name}}: Django, Django Headless, Content Studio and Astro, created with DjangoStack.

scripts.backend: docker compose exec backend python manage.py
scripts.test: docker compose exec backend pytest && docker compose exec frontend npm test
scripts.lint: docker compose exec backend ruff check . && docker compose exec frontend npm run check
scripts.generate:types: docker compose exec backend python manage.py generateschema --generator_class headless.rest.schema.SchemaGenerator --format openapi-json --file openapi.json && docker compose run --rm --no-deps -v ./backend/openapi.json:/schema.json:ro frontend npx headless generate --file /schema.json --out src/lib/headless.ts
